am_bidrag.description: Arbejdsmarkedsbidrag (labour market contribution). Applied to AM-bidragsgrundlag = gross income minus the employee's ATP contribution.

personal_allowance.description: Personfradrag for adults, 2026. Reduces the base for bundskat, kommuneskat and kirkeskat.

state_tax_brackets.description: Applied progressively to personlig indkomst (personal income), which is AM-bidragsgrundlag minus AM-bidrag. Bottom tax base is additionally reduced by the personal allowance. Thresholds are the after-AM-bidrag figures published by skat.dk.

mellemskat.note: New in the 2026 reform. Applies to personal income above this threshold (also to capital income above DKK 55,000, not modelled in V1).

skatteloft.description: Skatteloft (PSL 19): ceiling on the combined rate of state personal-income tax plus municipal tax. Post-reform the ceiling is tiered by band. Church tax and AM-bidrag are outside the ceiling.
skatteloft.note: An earlier version stored only 0.4457 and did not enforce it, on the reasoning that the state rates alone (12.01+7.5+7.5+5 = 32.01%) never reach it. That reasoning was wrong: the ceiling covers municipal tax too. With municipal rates from 23.39% to 26.30%, the ceiling binds for every taxpayer above the mellemskat threshold in any municipality above roughly 25.06%, which is 75 of the 98 municipalities.

employment_allowance.description: Beskæftigelsesfradrag. 12.75% of AM-bidragsgrundlag (wage income before the 8% AM-bidrag is subtracted), capped at DKK 63,300/year. Full amount reached at DKK 496,471 annual income.

job_allowance.description: Jobfradrag. 4.5% of AM-bidragsgrundlag above DKK 235,200/year, capped at DKK 3,100/year. Full amount reached at DKK 304,089 annual income.

rounding.display: ROUND_HALF_UP to the nearest whole DKK per breakdown line
rounding.note: See docs/research_2026.md section 12 for full rounding assumptions.

holiday_pay.description: Hourly-wage employees (timelønnede) receive feriegodtgørelse at 12.5% of gross wage; salaried employees (funktionærer, fixed_salary mode) instead get paid holiday plus a 1% ferietillæg. Both are AM-bidrag-liable A-indkomst taxed at the employee's current marginal/withholding rate, with no additional ATP. See docs/research_2026.md item 13a.

extra_deduction.description: Optional user-supplied additional ligningsmæssigt fradrag (e.g. union dues, commuting deduction) not otherwise modelled. Reduces skattepligtig indkomst (the municipal/church tax base), the same base the employment and job allowances reduce. Does NOT reduce personlig indkomst or duplicate the automatic personfradrag. See docs/research_2026.md item 13c.

am_bidrag_age_exemption.app_rule: age <= 17 (current age, as entered by the user) is treated as exempt from AM-bidrag
am_bidrag_age_exemption.verified_rule: The exemption runs through the income year in which the person turns 17 — i.e. it is a whole-tax-year rule keyed to whether the person turns 18 at any point during the year, not the person's age at the moment of calculation.
am_bidrag_age_exemption.known_limitation: This app only collects current age (an integer), not date of birth, so it cannot implement the verified whole-year rule exactly. A person who is 17 today but turns 18 later this year is NOT exempt for the full year under the verified rule, but this app's simplified 'age <= 17' check will still mark them exempt. This is a documented, deliberate simplification — not a silent assumption — and is surfaced in both the UI and the result's assumptions list whenever the exemption is applied.
am_bidrag_age_exemption.not_verified: ATP eligibility by age was not independently verified in V1.2 and is left unchanged (ATP is still charged per the existing hours-based table regardless of age). Employment allowance, job allowance and personfradrag for minors are assumed unchanged; no source was found stating otherwise.
